CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n0), an explicit origin/organization entry for that same referent/time, and separate content identification are all present.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Report explicitly identifies content (color 'red') and its coordinates for a current entry.

D.rationale: Content identification (red coordinates) is presented separately from an explicit origin/representation-status field for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report states how the content is represented/accessed via explicit origin/represented_time metadata for the current entry.
